notes: This contract pins the bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 FOM composition checks for data-type representation references and the two standard object-instance identifier references. The preflight rejects unresolved simple/enumerated representations, rejects basic-data or reference-data representations in an ordinary reference data type, and applies the reviewed special-instance-identifier exception with the standardized HLAunicodeString/HLAobjectInstanceHandle representations. The simple-data source wording remains under the RL-009 interpretation: the official MIM/Restaurant DIF pair uses the enumerated HLAboolean type as a simple-data representation, so simple data is checked for resolution rather than a basic-data category. The separate fom-enumerated-representation-requirements-contract.json contract pins the unambiguous 2025 basic-data predicate for enumerated representations. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service evidence claim.
